newsitem.title: UK: NWE gasoline firmer on NYMEX, strong bids.
newsitem.headline: NWE gasoline firmer on NYMEX, strong bids.

text.p: NWE gasoline prices gained around $3 a tonne on Monday, partly as a result of stronger NYMEX unleaded gasoline futures, and partly because of strong bids which at times were above the level of current offers, traders said.

Eurograde barges traded in the afternoon at $210 a tonne fob ARA for refinery-origin material, after earlier trading at $208, $204.50 and $207. Traders said the latter deal was concluded at a time when the offer for the same material was at $206.
"It is a thin market and that makes it easier to exert an influence on prices," one trader said.
Regular gasoline was also traded at $201.75 fob ARA.
Cargoes were not heard traded although the buyer of the barge at $210 was heard to be bidding into Hamburg at $218 cif or even higher. -- Nicholas Shaxson, London newsroom +44 171 542 8167
